description:
Give in-process suites one way to build a memory store and executor from declared configuration, rules and templates on top of the shared memory executor.

## Background

The shared memory executor (`crate::commands::test_helpers::memory_executor`) is set up by product initialisation. In-process suites build their own `InMemoryStorage` and write `config.toml`, `rules.toml` or `templates.toml` around it before calling it.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Shared test support builds a memory store and executor from caller-supplied configuration, rules and templates, on top of the shared memory executor.
- [hard] REQ-02: A unit test proves that the supplied declarations are what the executor loads and that unsupplied ones are product defaults.


Scope (steward ruling): this task adds the shared definition only; existing copies are retired by the adoption tasks that depend on it.
title: Shared memory executor accepts declarations as data
